summary: Frontend-only test for SinaisTab trigger re-fire bug fix. All 7 scenarios PASSED in a single browser session. The critical bug (signal not re-firing when the same trigger number reappears) is FIXED.
critical_code_review_comments: SinaisTab.jsx lines 123-151: Signal logic is now clean and correct - each new giro either resolves an active signal (hit/miss) or, if no active signal, fires a new one when lastNum is in triggerNums. Matches spec exactly.
prevGirosKeyRef guard (lines 99-115) correctly prevents duplicate processing on state re-renders and clears signals when giros array shrinks (undo/clear).
Edge case (minor, carried over): undo after a resolved signal could produce stale behavior since scores aren't rolled back — low impact, not part of this bug fix.
sessionStorage 'gatilho_scores' accumulates entries for deleted strategies (carried from prior iterations). Total scoreboard sums across all keys.
seed_data_creation: Seeded via localStorage: sinais_strategies=[{id:'s1', name:'Test', triggerNums:[5], entryNums:[34,20,15], active:true}]
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix verified. Test flow (giros [5]->[5,34]->[5,34,5]->[5,34,5,1,3,7]->[5,34,5,1,3,7,5]->[5,34,5,1,3,7,5,20]->[5,34,5,1,3,7,5,20,1]): T1 Enter 5 -> signal fires with entries 34,20,15 and '3 tentativas restantes'. T2 Enter 34 (hit) -> signal disappears, GREEN:1. T3 CRITICAL Enter 5 again -> signal fires again (bug was here, now working). T4 Enter 1,3,7 (3 misses) -> signal disappears, RED:1. T5 Enter 5 3rd time -> signal fires (GREEN:1 RED:1). T6 Enter 20 (hit) -> GREEN:2. T7 Enter 1 (non-trigger) -> no signal. All confirmed via [data-testid=signal-active-s1] presence, activeText contents, and [data-testid=gatilho-scoreboard-total] innerText.
